scope: C07 customer COD cancellation/return disclosure and policy version recording
approvalReason: Customer-facing operational policy wording is being changed; owner review of the concrete text precedes publication. This is not a new monetary rule or a legal compliance certification.
findings: Historical 179 evidence was a commercial pricing reader publication, not proof of customer cancellation terms coverage
Old customer terms promised payment before preparation, five-minute free cancellation, electronic refunds in 3-7 days and hard-coded unverified support contacts
Actual cash route cancels immediately only while pending without preparation, assignment or conflicting state; after acceptance a review request does not stop the order
Return, custody, responsibility, fare and merchant compensation are independent reviewed decisions; no automatic customer cash refund or extra return fee
Food perishability and other goods require case-specific review; no automatic eligibility for all categories
Claim, appeal and response timing remain with existing applicable case policy and server eligibility; no new numerical promise invented

customer: Replace inaccurate static payment/cancellation/refund text and fictitious support contacts
Readable navy text and white/light cards; no yellow text on white
Policy link in checkout and exact server policy document in confirmation sheet
Server supplies policy document with canonical hash; client validates hash and shows matching version
Explicit commercial review carries only policy pin in persisted account-scoped order attempt
Policy change forces another review even if prices unchanged
Prepared invoice Arabic policy uses UTF-8 and avoids redundant preview
backend: Validate optional pin against current server policy before new order commit
Store immutable full document, subject, server creation time and commercial digest with acknowledged new-client order
Older clients without pin remain compatible and are explicitly marked NOT_RECORDED_BY_CLIENT; never fabricate acknowledgement
Existing retries keep original order outcome and record; no rewriting historical orders
No extra tables, financial postings, charges, IAM grants, environment changes or SLA changes
merchantDriverAdmin: Audited operational return/custody/fare/compensation wording and backend rules; no contradictory consumer refund promise located in active operational components searched
Existing commercial agreements, driver statements and administrative case policy snapshots remain separate from consumer text
Legacy email signup terms checkboxes exist; their route activation and full partner onboarding terms coverage are not claimed verified by this targeted C07 task

remaining: Owner review and publication of exact text and code package
Install updated customer app and complete ordered human acceptance
Broader partner signup terms/consent route audit remains separate and tracked
X-TEST-342 historical fixture debt remains open; targeted 343 passing tests do not clear it
